StringProperty.Name: Target Triple
StringProperty.Description: Specifies the platform the code is made for, as arch-vendor-os; makes Clang a cross compiler.

EnumProperty.Name: C++ Standard Library
EnumProperty.Description: Specifies the C++ standard library the program is compiled and linked with.

BoolProperty.Name: Every Warning
BoolProperty.Description: Enables every warning Clang has, including those that are of little use. Meant for finding what to switch off.
